name: Battery-charger AC input feeder
summary: Identifies the protected AC circuit supplying the assigned station battery charger.
description: Identifies the protected AC circuit supplying the assigned station battery charger. An auxiliary AC distribution diagram identifies the supplies serving room services and control-support equipment. Essential, backed-up and ordinary circuits can have different source paths and operating priorities.

In a switchroom, the lighting, service sockets, charger input and room cooling may be fed from different auxiliary branches. A source change must preserve the identities of loads that require continuity. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Auxiliary AC board” at the input and “Charger AC input” at the output. Charger output has a separate DC distribution path.
